title: VIA database and data contract
purpose: Connect modules to local DuckDB and Parquet data through explicit schema, grain, lineage, incremental and checkpoint contracts.

steps.action: Inspect existing local data and checkpoint before any network fetch.
Validate source, grain, primary key, schema, unit, timezone and adjusted-price semantics.
Plan incremental append, deduplication and atomic checkpoint update.
Expose original and net-of-day-trade Taiwan volume views without overwriting raw data.
